focus: A diversified product portfolio includes HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, HFFR, PVC, cable filling, and adhesive coating compounds primarily serving the wire, cable, and infrastructure industries.
We have also built a diversified customer and geographical presence, serving customers across 24 states in India and exporting our products to 13 countries.

Alongside capacity expansion, we will continue to focus on increasing the share of value-added products, strengthening our existing customer relationship, and exploring new domestic and international markets.
